subject: Quick walkthrough — 20-minute slot options & reschedule
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@lumenai.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick walkthrough — 20-min slot options

Hi Liam —

Noticed a recent spike from you and the team (congrats!) — you crossed our 100k token threshold yesterday. I don't want you to feel stuck while exploring higher-throughput patterns. Do you have 20 minutes this week for a quick walkthrough to show ways we typically reduce per-token cost and set up safe cache/rollout defaults?

Here are a few windows I have open (PT):
- Tue 10/10: 9:30–10:00 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 10/11: 11:00–11:30 or 15:30–16:00

If none of those work, reply with two 20-min windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I attached a quick-setup guide that shows the simple batching + prefix cache we usually enable for this pattern.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Development Rep | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: quick-setup-guide.pdf (1.2 MB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@lumenai.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Oct 2028 18:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick walkthrough — 20-min slot options

Thanks Ben —

Appreciate the ping. We rolled a couple of experiments yesterday and I do want to sync. Wed 10/11 at 11:00 PT should work for me, but two quick asks before we lock it in:
1) Our security lead (Sophie Hart) will want to verify where logs are retained and whether we can disable request logging for certain routes.
2) Can this be recorded or do you have a one-pager we can share internally?

Looping in Sophie so she can confirm availability. If Sophie can't make it we'll still do 20 minutes and take notes.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor | Head of Platform Engineering, LumenAI
liam@lumenai.io | +1 646-555-0133

Great — thanks for confirming. Wed 10/11 at 11:00 PT is on my calendar; I've tentatively held it for 20 minutes. Ben, Marissa and I will be present. Sophie, welcome — if you can make that time, we’ll cover where logs are stored by default, our opt-out controls, and a short overview of the Private deployment options (VPC/KMS) that customers use if they need no-log configurations. If you prefer, we can also have the security deep-dive after the initial 20-minute sync.

I attached a one-pager with the capabilities we typically highlight and a mutual action plan template you can use to collate requirements internally. If we need to reschedule, please reply with times that work — otherwise I’ll confirm and send calendar invites + a Calendly fallback link.
